name: Scar-Sink Prayer
activeText: Scar-Sink Prayer — Admit the Fear: Reaction — When one of your Scars creates a pending consequence, spend 1 charge to ignore one pending effect from that Scar trigger. The Scar remains, the trigger still counts as having occurred, and all other pending Scar effects resolve normally.
flavor: A prayer wheel packed with ash-cold teeth and stolen ventilation rites.
